posts.title: The BBC and CNN were loading Optimizely without consent six weeks before it was turned against their visitors
posts.description: Signed captures show the BBC and CNN loading Optimizely without consent six weeks before it was hijacked to serve malware. Consent would have limited the harm.

posts.title: Capture the Code - visualising the scale of website surveillance
posts.description: A procedurally rendered film of our forensic audit of the 100 most visited English-language content websites, showing where visitors' data goes - before anyone consents.

posts.title: Shopify's own code treats silence as consent on every store it hosts, while its DSA filings leave the user numbers blank
posts.description: Shopify's code fabricates consent that was never given, its telemetry sends data it marked untrackable and its DSA filings leave the EU user count blank. I have filed two complaints.
